description: Turn an explicit trade intent into exact executable terms without trading: market, side, human and raw amounts, quote source and time, minimum received or limit price, funding plan, expiry (60s). Returns a previewId for gdex_execute_trade. kind=spot (USDC wallet), perp_open, perp_close. For perps give notionalUsd (position size) or marginUsd (collateral), never guess which.

amount.description: spot: USDC to spend (buy) or token amount (sell)

autoFunding.description: spot buy: bridge USDC/gas from other chains (default true)

coin.description: perp: e.g. BTC, or xyz:TSLA for builder DEXes

dex.description: perp_close: builder DEX for a bare coin

leverage.description: perp_open: leverage (backend: cross on core perps, isolated on builder-DEX markets)

name: gdex_preview_trade
